title: Modern Beta Forge Voronoi Climates
description: Adds biome generation with customizable biome maps and a visual editor for Modern Beta Forge 1.12.2
body: ## Custom Biome Generation for Modern Beta Forge 1.12.2! An add-on for [Modern Beta Forge for 1.12.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/modern-beta-forge) (versions 1.9.0.0 or later) which adds Voronoi-based biome generation with customizable biome maps through an in-game visual editor. Includes options to generate climatic biome maps that are mod-friendly! ### Usage For quick usage, customize the Modern Beta world type, then go to Presets, and finally select from one of the provided presets: * _Vanilla Climatic_ -- A simple biome map that uses most vanilla biomes. * _Beta Climatic_ -- A biome map that replicates Beta biome distribution. Alternatively, you can create and modify your own custom biome maps by selecting the Voronoi biome source option and opening the Biome Map editor from the _Add-on_ tab. The mod features a visual editor that allows users to quickly create, modify, and understand how biomes are placed. Either create your own biome map from scratch or generate an approximate climate map based on biomes' built-in temperature and rainfall values. Certain types of elevation-based biomes are excluded (e.g. hills, mountains, oceans, etc.), which can adjusted from the mod's config menu. You can also adjust biome size by increasing/decreasing the temperature, rainfall, and detail scale values. ### Server Usage The following should be done in the server.properties file: * Set the 'levelType' field to 'modernbeta', without the quotes. * Set generation options in the 'generator-settings' field. You can create the generator options string using the in-game GUI.
